name: nww-v14
description: NWW-V14: nww-v12 内核 + AI-Novel-Writing-Assistant 前端UI 整合版

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @ai-novel/shared build && concurrently -n kernel,server,client -c blue,green,yellow "pnpm dev:kernel" "pnpm dev:server" "pnpm dev:client"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ai-novel/shared build && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/server build && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/client build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @ai-novel/shared build && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/client typecheck
